cases.prompt: Summarise Northvale's 2025 growth in solar capacity and battery storage in two or three sentences. Use only the sources. Put the source number in square brackets, like [1], directly after each claim it supports.

sources.title: Northvale Energy Report 2025
sources.text: Northvale installed 412 megawatts of new solar capacity in 2025, up from 290 megawatts in 2024. Most of the growth came from rooftop systems.

sources.title: Northvale Grid Operator bulletin, January 2026
sources.text: Battery storage connected to the Northvale grid reached 150 megawatts in December 2025, three times the level of a year earlier.

sources.title: Northvale Tourism Board annual review
sources.text: Northvale recorded 2.1 million visitors in 2025, a record for the region.
